---
title: "Omega-3 + RT on metabolic syndrome"
format:
  typst:
    fig-format: svg
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

## Outline

- Primary (logistic regression)
  -	Does omega-3 supplementation, strength training, or their combination reduce the prevalence of metabolic syndrome compared to placebo?
- Secondary (LMM)
  -	How do the interventions affect each component of metabolic syndrome?
  -	Are the effects additive or synergistic?
- Exploratory
  -	Does supplementation compliance, verified by RBC EPA+DHA percentage, predict improvements in metabolic outcomes?
  -	Do baseline characteristics (sex, age, BMI, initial metabolic syndrome components) influence responsiveness? 

- For discussion:
  -	Feasibility, effectiveness, and clinically meaningful changes?

```{r}
# Color scale
colscale <-  c("#009E73", "#D55E00", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", 
                "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#CC79A7", "#000000")


alpha_theme <- function(yaxis = TRUE) {
  
  if(yaxis) {
 fun <-  theme_classic() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())
  }
   if(!yaxis) {
   fun <-  theme_classic() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.y = element_blank())
     
   }
  
  
  return(fun)
  
}





# Should models be refitted?
refit.models <- FALSE



# Helper functions ############################################################

# Wrapper function for sampling from Stan models. 
#
# When models are run and fits are stored the function retrieves the fit 
# from storage. This will make it easier to work with the qmd document.  
#
#
# model, a compiled Stan model object
# DATA, the data set used to fit the model
# fit, name of the fitted model
# iter, number of iterations
# iterwu, number of iterations in war-up
# chains, number of chains
# pchains, number of parrallel chains, 
# refresh, progress refresh
fit_wrap <- function(model, 
         DATA = d, 
         fit = "fit.m1",
         iter = 2000, 
         iterwu = 1000, 
         chains = 4, 
         pchains = 4, 
         refresh = 1000, 
         refit = refit.models) {
  
  fit.filepath <- paste0("fits/paper1/", fit, ".RDS")
  
  # If refit is set to true in the document, all model fits will be refitted
  if(refit) file.remove(fit.filepath)
  
  # Sample from the model if a saved version does not exixts.
  if(!file.exists(fit.filepath)) {
    
      fittedmodel <- model$sample(
        data = DATA,                 # The list of variables
        iter_sampling = iter,        # Number of iterations for sampling
        iter_warmup = iterwu,        # Number of warm-up iterations
        chains = chains,             # Number of Markov chains
        parallel_chains = pchains,   # Number of parallel chains
        refresh = refresh)           # Number of iterations before each print
    # Save the model for easy access
     fittedmodel$save_object(file = fit.filepath)  # <-- use this
  } else {
    fittedmodel <- readRDS(fit.filepath)
  }
  # Assign the model object to the environment. 
    assign(fit, fittedmodel, envir = parent.frame())
}


#
```

```{r}
part <- AOData::idkeys  
  
## Descriptives data 
baseline_dat <- AOData::bodycomp |>
  select(participant, time, lean.whole, BMC.whole, fat.whole)  |>
  mutate(weight = lean.whole + BMC.whole + fat.whole) |>
  inner_join(part) |>
  filter(time == "T1") |>
  ## Calculate height based on weight (DXA) and BMI 
  mutate(height = 100 * sqrt((weight/1000) / bmi)) |>
  ## Calculate relative lean and fat
  mutate(lean.rel = 100 * (lean.whole / weight), 
         fat.rel = 100 * (fat.whole/weight), 
         # Weight in kg
         weight = weight / 1000) |>
  select(participant, 
         treat, 
         completed, 
         sex, 
         age, 
         height, 
         weight, 
         bmi) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = age:bmi)
  
  
## Included participants 
total_participants <- baseline_dat |> 
  distinct(participant) |> 
  pull(participant)




# Per completed period

#             m = mean(value), 
#             s = sd(value),

n_male_omega <- n_total[1,3][[1]]
n_female_omega <- n_total[3,3][[1]]
n_male_ctrl <-  n_total[2,3][[1]]
n_female_ctrl <-  n_total[4,3][[1]]





baseline_dat |> 
  summarise(.by = c(treat, sex, name), 
            m = mean(value), 
            s = sd(value), 
            min = min(value), 
            max = max(value), 
            n = n()) |> 
  mutate(stats = paste0(
    sprintf("%.0f", round(m, 0)), 
    " (", 
    sprintf("%.0f", round(s, 0)), 
    ") [",
    sprintf("%.0f", round(min, 0)), 
    " - ", 
    sprintf("%.0f", round(max, 0)), 
    "]"), 
    n = n) |> 
  
  dplyr::select(treat, sex, name,n, stats) |> 
  

  
  dplyr::select(-n) |> 
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = treat, 
              values_from = stats) |> 
  
  mutate(sex = if_else(sex == "m", "Male", "Female"), 
         name = case_when(
           name == "age" ~ "Age (years)", 
           name == "height" ~ "Stature (cm)", 
           name == "weight" ~ "Body mass (kg)", 
           name == "bmi" ~ "Body mass index (kg&times;m^-2^)", 
           TRUE ~ NA )) |> 

  group_by(sex) |> 
  gt() |> 
  fmt_markdown() |> 
  
  cols_label(omega = md(paste0("N-3<br>(&male; n = ", 
                               n_male_omega, 
                               "; &female; n = ", 
                               n_female_omega, ")")),
             ctrl = md(paste0("Placebo<br>(&male; n = ", 
                              n_male_ctrl, 
                              "; &female; n = ",
                              n_female_ctrl, ")")), 
             sex = "", 
             name = "") |> 
  tab_footnote(footnote = "Data are presnted as Mean (SD) [Min-Max]")
```

## Results


```{r}
#| label: data-prep
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false


# Data prep. ##################################################################
# Outcomes in the study are:
# - Metabolic syndrome (with sub-scores) (primary)
#   * Triglycerides
#   * Waist circumference
#   * Blood pressure 
#   * HDL Cholesterol
#   * Resting glucose
# - Body mass index
# - Relative fat mass
# - OGTT
# - HOMA2-IR
 


## Body composition 
body_comp <-  AOData::bodycomp |> 
  select(participant, time, lean.whole, BMC.whole, fat.whole)  |> 
  mutate(weight = lean.whole + BMC.whole + fat.whole) |>
  inner_join(part) |>
  filter(time %in%  c("T1", "T2", "T4")) |>
  ## Calculate height based on weight (DXA) and BMI 
  mutate(height = if_else(time == "T1", 
                          100 * sqrt((weight/1000) / bmi), 
                          NA)) |>
  mutate(.by = participant, 
         height = mean(height, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 

  
  ## Calculate relative lean and fat
  mutate(lean.rel = 100 * (lean.whole / weight), 
         fat.rel = 100 * (fat.whole / weight), 
         # Weight in kg
         weight = weight / 1000, 
         bmi = weight * (height/100)^-2 ) |>

  select(participant, time, sex, fat.rel, bmi) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = fat.rel:bmi, 
               names_to = "analyte", 
               values_to = "value") |> 
  mutate(threshold = NA) 
  
  
### Glucose data 
glucose_dat <- AOData::glucose |> 
  inner_join( idkeys |> 
               select(participant, sex)) |> 
  filter(min == 0) |> 
  select(participant, sex, time, HOMA2IR) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = HOMA2IR, 
               names_to = "analyte", 
               values_to = "value") |> 
  mutate(threshold = NA) 




# Combine all data from metabolic syndrome criteria variables
criteria_dat <- bind_rows(
  # HDL Cholesterol: <40 mg/dL for men, <50 mg/dL for women, or taking medication for it.
  AOData::bloodvar |> 
  inner_join(AOData::idkeys |> 
               select(participant, sex)) |> 
  filter(analyte == "HDL") |> 
  # Convert to mg/dl: 1 mmol/L = 38,6654 mg/dL
  mutate(hdl = if_else(sex == "m",
                       if_else(value * 38.6654 < 40, TRUE, FALSE), 
                       if_else(value * 38.6654 < 50, TRUE, FALSE))) |> 
  select(participant, time, sex, analyte, value, threshold = hdl), 
  
  # Fasting Glucose: 100 mg/dL or higher, or taking medication for it.
  
  AOData::glucose |> 
  filter(min == 0) |> 
  filter(!is.na(glucose)) |> 
  select(participant, time, glucose) |>
  inner_join(AOData::idkeys |> 
               select(participant, sex)) |> 
  # Convert to mg/dl: 1 mmol/L = 18,0156 mg/dL
  mutate(threshold = if_else(glucose * 18.0156 > 100, TRUE, FALSE), 
         analyte = "glucose") |> 
  select(participant, time, sex, analyte, value = glucose, threshold), 
  
  # Triglycerides: 150 mg/dL or higher, or taking medication for it.
  
  AOData::bloodvar |> 
  filter(analyte == "TG") |> 
  inner_join(AOData::idkeys |> 
               select(participant, sex)) |> 
  # Convert to mg/dl: 1 mmol/L = 88.57 mg/dL
  mutate(tg = if_else(value * 88.57 > 150, TRUE, FALSE)) |> 
  select(participant, time, sex, analyte, value, threshold = tg), 
  
  # Waist circumference: >40 inches (102 cm) for men, >35 inches (88 cm) for women.
  
  AOData::waist_bp |> 
  filter(measure == "waist") |> 
  mutate(waist = if_else(sex == "m", 
                         if_else(value > 102, TRUE, FALSE), 
                         if_else(value > 88, TRUE, FALSE))) |> 
  select(participant, time, sex, analyte = measure, value, threshold = waist) |> 
  filter(!is.na(value)),
  
  # Blood Pressure: 130/85 mm Hg or higher, or taking medication for it.
  
  AOData::waist_bp |> 
  filter(measure != "waist") |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = value) |> 
  mutate(bp = if_else(sys > 130 | dias > 85, TRUE, FALSE), 
         map = dias + ((sys-dias)/3), 
         analyte = "bp") |> 
  select(participant, time, sex, analyte, value = map, threshold = bp) |> 
  filter(!is.na(value)), 
  # Add body composition 
  body_comp, 
  # Add homa2IR
  glucose_dat
  ) |> 
  # Create binomial variable for individual criteria
  mutate(crit = if_else(threshold == TRUE, 1, 0)) |> 
  inner_join(idkeys |> 
               select(participant, treat, age, sex))   |> 
  
  # Filter to correspond to total participants
  filter(participant %in% total_participants)
  
  



# Data set for complete-case analysis ##########################################
# These are participants with complete cases for the main outcome (met syndrome) 
# from T1 to T4. No missing values are allowed in the complete case analysis.
# For the missingness analysis, participants completing T2 are also sorted out.
participant_complete_T4 <- criteria_dat |> 
  filter(analyte %in% c("HDL", 
                        "TG", 
                        "waist", 
                        "glucose", 
                        "bp")) |> 
  select(participant, time, treat, sex, analyte, value) |> 
  # Critera measures
  pivot_wider(names_from = analyte, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  filter(complete.cases(pick(HDL:bp))) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = HDL:bp)  |> 
  
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  filter(complete.cases(pick(T2, T4))) |> 
  distinct(participant) |> 
  pull(participant)


participant_complete_T2 <- criteria_dat |> 
  filter(analyte %in% c("HDL", 
                        "TG", 
                        "waist", 
                        "glucose", 
                        "bp")) |> 
  select(participant, time, treat, sex, analyte, value) |> 
  # Critera measures
  pivot_wider(names_from = analyte, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  filter(complete.cases(pick(HDL:bp))) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = HDL:bp)  |> 
  
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  filter(complete.cases(pick(T2))) |> 
  distinct(participant) |> 
  pull(participant)

# All participants at baseline 







```


### Missing data analysis

To assess if our outcome variables predict drop-out we fit a logistic regression model 

$$
\begin{align}
D_i &\sim \operatorname{Bernoulli}(p_i) \\
\operatorname{Logit}(p_i) &= \alpha_{[A]} + \beta_{X[A]} X_i + \beta_{S[A]} S_i + \beta_{T[A]} T_i + \beta__{TX[A]} T_i X_i \\
\alpha_{[A]}, \beta_{X[A]}, \beta_{S[A]}, \beta_{T[A]}, \beta_{TX[A]} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0, 0.5) \\
\end{align}
$$

```{r}
#| label: fig-descriptive-data
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-cap: "Observed data distributions of main outcomes."



d_full <- criteria_dat |> 
  
  select(participant, time, treat, sex, age, analyte, value) |> 

  # Add missing values for all missing obs. 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = value) |> 

  pivot_longer(cols = c(T1, T2, T4), 
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "time" ) |> 
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = analyte, 
              values_from = value) |> 

    pivot_longer(cols = HDL:HOMA2IR, 
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "analyte" ) |> 
  
  
  mutate(value_std = if_else(analyte == "TG", log(value), value)) |> 
  
  mutate(.by = analyte, 
         value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  # To make all variables similarly signed HDL is reversed. 
  # Expected improvement in scores will be in the negative direction 
  # for all criteria markers
  mutate(value_std = if_else(analyte == "HDL", 
                         -value_std, value_std)) |> 
  mutate(participant = paste0("p", participant))
```

```{r}
#| label: missing-data-prep
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| output: false



# Does baseline characteristics predict drop-out?

miss_dat <- criteria_dat |> 
  select(- threshold, -crit) |> 
  # Filter for time-point 1
  filter(time == "T1") |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = analyte, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = age:HOMA2IR, 
               values_to = "value", 
               names_to = "analyte")  |> 
    mutate(.by = analyte, 
         value_std = if_else(analyte %in% c("TG", "HOMA2IR"), log(value), value), 
         value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) 

## For mean-centering 
baseline_cent <- miss_dat |> 
  summarise(.by = analyte, 
            m = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            s = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            nas = sum(is.na(value_std)), 
            n = n()) |> 
  mutate(nas = nas / n) 


miss_dat2 <- miss_dat |> 
  filter(!is.na(value_std)) |> 
  # Missing at follow-up
  mutate(
    miss_t4 = if_else(participant %in% participant_complete_T4, 0, 1), 
    miss_t2 = if_else(participant %in% participant_complete_T2, 0, 1), 
    P = dense_rank(participant), 
    A = dense_rank(analyte), 
    TX= if_else(treat == "ctrl", -0.5, 0.5), 
    S = if_else(sex == "m", -0.5, 0.5),
  ) 
  
  
# Prepare list for model 
d <- list(
  N = nrow(miss_dat2), 
  N_A = length(unique(miss_dat2$A)), 
  N_P = length(unique(miss_dat2$P)), 
  N_TX =length(unique(miss_dat2$TX)), 
  N_S = length(unique(miss_dat2$S)), 
  # Indicators
  P = miss_dat2$P,           # Participant
  A = miss_dat2$A,           # Outcome/Analyte
  TX= miss_dat2$TX,          # Treatment
  
  # Predictors
  S = miss_dat2$S,           # sex
  x = miss_dat2$value_std,   # outcome std value
  do4 = miss_dat2$miss_t4,   # Drop-out to T4 
  do2 = miss_dat2$miss_t2,    # Drop-out to T2
  
  prior_only = 1
  
)



# Compiling the model
m1 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m1.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/m1.exe")



fit_wrap(m1,fit = "fit.m1", DATA = d)


```


```{r}
#| label: fig-dropout-priorpredictive
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive simulation for model 1. Columns are values of the predictor (SD-units) rows represents each predictor."


draws.m1 <- fit.m1$draws(format = "df")


draws.m1 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with(c("alpha2", "beta2"))) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "A"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  mutate(A = gsub("\\]", "", A)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  # Adding predictor variables
  expand_grid(x = seq(from = -3, to = 3, by = 3), 
                TX = c(-0.5, 0.5)) |>
  
  mutate(log_odds = alpha2 + beta2_x * x + beta2_tx * TX + beta2_xtx * TX * x, 
         prob = plogis(log_odds)) |> 
  mutate(Treatment = if_else(TX == -0.5, "Placebo", "N-3")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(prob, color = Treatment)) + 
  geom_line(stat = "density") +
  facet_grid( A ~ x ) +
  labs(x = "Drop-out probability", 
       y = "Prior density") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale)

  
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-dropout-across
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-cap: "Probability of drop-out across values of baseline co-variates on per treatment group to time-point 2 (A) and 4 (B). Estimates are adjusted for sex, intervals are 90% percentile interval."

a <- draws.m1 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with(c("alpha2", "beta2"))) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "A"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  mutate(A = gsub("\\]", "", A)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  # Adding predictor variables
  expand_grid(x = seq(from = -3, to = 3, by = 0.1), 
                TX = c(-0.5, 0.5)) |>
  
  mutate(log_odds = alpha2 + beta2_x * x + beta2_tx * TX + beta2_xtx * TX * x, 
         prob = plogis(log_odds), 
         Treatment = if_else(TX == -0.5, "Placebo", "N-3")) |> 
  

  summarise(.by = c(A, Treatment, x), 
            mprob = mean(prob), 
            lwr = quantile(prob, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(prob, 0.95)) |> 
  
  # Inner join transforming to centering
  inner_join(
    miss_dat2 |> 
  distinct(A, analyte) |> 
  mutate(
```

### N-3 supplementation and fatty acid profiles

Fatty acids, including including EPA (C205n3) and DHA (226n3) where measured in whole blood. We will assess the effect of supplementation on group level fatty acid profiles using mixed-effects models. As preliminary models indicated heteroscedasticity of residuals, log-transformed data was used in modelling.



```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive check for target-wise models of post-treatment fatty acid concentrations conditional on pre-treatment values. The model expects log-transformed standardized values and the priors suggest no difference between treatment groups and a proportional relationship between th pre-intervention values and post-intervention measurements."
#| label: fig-m2-priorpred
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| output: false


fat_dat <- AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4"), 
         participant %in% total_participants) |>
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) |>
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value")  |> 
  mutate(.by = fa, 
         value_std = log(value), 
         value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std)) / sd(value_std)) |> 
  mutate(FA = dense_rank(fa), 
         TX = dense_rank(treat)) 
  
  
# Fatty acid summarise  
fat_sum <- fat_dat |> 
    summarise(.by = c(FA,fa), 
              m = mean(log(value)), 
              s = sd(log(value)))
  
  

# Check n 
fat_n <- fat_dat |> 
  distinct(time, treat, participant) |> 
  summarise(.by = c(time, treat), 
            n = n())

# Filter for complete case and prep data 

fat_dat2 <- fat_dat |> 
  select(participant, FA, TX, time, value_std) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = value_std) |> 
  filter(complete.cases(pick(T1:T4))) |> 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "TI", 
               values_to = "y", 
               cols = T2:T4) |> 
  mutate(TI = dense_rank(TI), 
         P = dense_rank(participant))


d <- list(
  # Length of indices
  N    = nrow(fat_dat2), 
  N_FA = length(unique(fat_dat2$FA)),
  N_P  = length(unique(fat_dat2$P)),
  N_TX = length(unique(fat_dat2$TX)),
  N_TI = length(unique(fat_dat2$TI)),
  # Indicators 
  P = fat_dat2$P, 
  FA = fat_dat2$FA, 
  TX = fat_dat2$TX,
  TI = fat_dat2$TI,
  # Co-variate and outcome
  pre = fat_dat2$T1, 
  y = fat_dat2$y, 
  # Prior only flag
  prior_only = 1

)



# Compiling the model
m2 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m2.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/m2.exe")


fit_wrap(m2, fit = "fit.m2", DATA = d)


draws.m2 <- fit.m2$draws(format = "df")


draws.m2 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  inner_join(
    draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 

  
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.1)) |> 
   
  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(FA, TI, TX, pre), 
            m = mean(mu), 
            lwr = quantile(mu, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(mu, 0.95)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(pre, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, 
             color = TX, 
             fill = TX)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.2, aes(color = NULL)) + 
  facet_grid(FA ~ TI)


```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: "Model performance metrics from Model 2."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-m2-modelperformance
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| output: false


d$prior_only <- 0

# Sample the posterior
fit_wrap(m2, fit = "fit.m2p", DATA = d)


# Model performance
sum.m2 <- fit.m2p$summary()

# Get (most) problematic parameters
vars <- sum.m2 |> 
  arrange(-rhat) |> 
   filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  slice_head(n = 3) |> 
  pull(variable)



p1 <- sum.m2 |> 
  filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  mutate(variable_type = variable) |> 
  separate(variable_type, into = c("variable_type", "index"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  
  mutate(highlight = if_else(variable %in% vars, variable, "")) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(ess_bulk, rhat, size = ess_tail, color = variable_type)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = highlight, 
                color = NULL, 
                size = NULL)) +
  
  labs(x = "(Bulk) effective sample size", 
       y = "R-hat", 
       color = "Parameter type", 
       size = "(Tail) effective sample size") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale)




draws.m2 <- fit.m2p$draws(format = "df")


p2  <- draws.m2 |> 
  select(.iteration, .chain, all_of(vars)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(.iteration, value, 
             color = as.factor(.chain))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ name, ncol = 1, 
             scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  labs(x = "Iteration", 
       color = "Chain", 
       y = "Parameter value")



p1 / p2
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6

draws.m2 |>
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Predictions of fatty acid concentration in response to treatment. Pre-intervention values are means per treatment group, post-intervention means are predicted from the model with 99% PI."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-m2-meanpred
#| message: false
#| warning: false



pre_int_means <- fat_dat2 |> 
  filter(TI == 1) |> 
  summarise(.by = FA, 
            pre = mean(T1))


m2_sum <- draws.m2 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 
  
  inner_join(pre_int_means) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre, 
         y_pred = rnorm(1, alpha + beta * pre, sigma)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  summarise(
    .by = c(FA, TI, TX), 
    Mu  = mean(mu), 
    lwr99 = quantile(mu, 0.005), 
    upr99 = quantile(mu, 0.995), 
    lwr50 = quantile(mu, 0.25), 
    upr50 = quantile(mu, 0.75),
    
    lwr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.05), 
    upr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.95) ) |> 
  
  # Back-transform all estimates
  pivot_longer(cols = Mu:upr_pred90, 
               names_to = "est", 
               values_to = "value") |> 
  inner_join(fat_sum) |> 
  
  mutate(value_org = exp(value * s + m)) |> 
  
  select(FA:est, fa, value_org) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = est, 
              values_from = value_org) |> 
  
  mutate(time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4"), 
         treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega"), 
         treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 

  add_row(
    fat_dat |> 
      filter(time == "T1") |> 
      summarise(.by = c(time, treat, fa), 
                Mu = mean(value)) |> 
      mutate(TX = NA, 
             TI = NA,
             FA = NA, 
              treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) 
  ) 
  
  

## Plotting predictions with data  
AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  filter(participant %in% fat_dat2$participant)  |> 

  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4")) |>

               values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
  
  
  ggplot(aes(time, value, color = treat, group = paste(participant, fa))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
  
   ## Add model predictions

  geom_errorbar(data = m2_sum, 
                aes(time, Mu,

                    group = treat,
                    color = NULL), 
                width = 0.1,

             aes(time, Mu, fill = treat, group = NULL),

             alpha = 1,
             shape = 21, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +

  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) +
  
   facet_wrap(~ fa, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(y = "Fatty acid concentration (&mu;g ml<sup>-1</sup>)", 
       x = "Time point", 
       fill = "Treatment",
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6

### Contrasts
draws.m2 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 

    # Compute contrasts
    mutate(treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega")) |> 
    select(.iteration:TI, treat, alpha) |> 
  
    pivot_wider(names_from = treat, 
                values_from = alpha) |> 
    
    mutate(contrats = omega - ctrl, 
           rel_contrast = exp(contrats), 
           time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4")) |>
    
    inner_join(fat_sum) |> 
    
    ggplot(aes(x = rel_contrast, 
               fill = time)) + 
    geom_density(alpha = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ fa, scales = "free") +
    
    labs(x = "Fold-difference (N-3 vs. Placebo)", 
         y = "Posterior density", 
         fill = "Time-point") +
    theme_classic() + 
  
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.2), 
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             lty = 2, 
             color = "gray50") +


  
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive check model 3 (data imputation)."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-m3-prior
#| message: false
#| warning: false



### Data imputation fatty acid profiles ###################



# Prepare data set with complete cases at baseline, imputation of missing values
# post-treatment.
fat_dat_compl <- AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4"), 
         participant %in% total_participants) |>
  
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) |>

  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value")  |> 
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  
  # Two participants have no data at T1
  filter(!is.na(T1)) |> 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "time", 
               values_to = "value", 
               cols = T1:T4) |> 
  mutate(.by = fa, 
         value_std = log(value), 
         value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
           sd(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(FA = dense_rank(fa), 
         TX = dense_rank(treat)) 
  
  
# Fatty acid summarise on complete data 
fat_sum_compl <- fat_dat |> 
    summarise(.by = c(FA,fa), 
              m = mean(log(value), na.rm = TRUE), 
              s = sd(log(value), na.rm = TRUE))


# Check n 
fat_n_compl <- fat_dat |> 
  distinct(time, treat, participant) |> 
  summarise(.by = c(time, treat), 
            n = n())

# Filter for complete case and prep data 
fat_dat_compl2 <- fat_dat_compl |> 
  select(participant, FA, TX, time, value_std) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = value_std) |> 

  pivot_longer(names_to = "TI", 
               values_to = "y", 
               cols = T2:T4) |> 
  mutate(TI = dense_rank(TI), 
         P = dense_rank(participant), 
         # Add missing data and fill y
         obs = if_else(is.na(y), 0, 1), 
         y = if_else(is.na(y), -999, y) )




d <- list(
  # Length of indices
  N    = nrow(fat_dat_compl2), 
  N_FA = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$FA)),
  N_P  = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$P)),
  N_TX = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$TX)),
  N_TI = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$TI)),
  # Indicators 
  P = fat_dat_compl2$P, 
  FA = fat_dat_compl2$FA, 
  TX = fat_dat_compl2$TX,
  TI = fat_dat_compl2$TI,
  # Co-variate and outcome
  pre = fat_dat_compl2$T1, 
  y = fat_dat_compl2$y, 
  obs = fat_dat_compl2$obs,
  # Prior only flag
  prior_only = 1
)


# Compiling the model
m3 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m3.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/m3.exe")


# Prior predictive check
fit_wrap(m3, DATA = d, fit = "fit.m3")

draws.m3 <- fit.m3$draws(format = "df")


draws.m3 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  inner_join(
    draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 

  
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.1)) |> 
   
  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(FA, TI, TX, pre), 
            m = mean(mu), 
            lwr = quantile(mu, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(mu, 0.95)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(pre, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, 
             color = TX, 
             fill = TX)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.2, aes(color = NULL)) + 
  facet_grid(FA ~ TI) + 
  labs(x = "Pre-inteverntion values", 
       y = "Prior predictive distribution of post-intervention values (std.)", 
       fill = "Treatment", 
       color = "Treatment") + 
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) 



```

```{r}
draws.m3 <- fit.m3p$draws(format = "df")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-cap: "Model predictions. Pre-intervention values are observed means, post-treatment (T2, T4) values are model predictions conditional pre-intervention value with 99% percentile intervals."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-m3-predictions
#| message: false
#| warning: false



pre_int_means <- fat_dat_compl2 |> 
  filter(TI == 1) |> 
  summarise(.by = FA, 
            pre = mean(T1))


m3_sum <- draws.m3 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 
  

  
  inner_join(pre_int_means) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  

  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre, 
         y_pred = rnorm(1, alpha + beta * pre, sigma)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  summarise(
    .by = c(FA, TI, TX), 
    Mu  = mean(mu), 
    lwr99 = quantile(mu, 0.005), 
    upr99 = quantile(mu, 0.995), 
    lwr50 = quantile(mu, 0.25), 
    upr50 = quantile(mu, 0.75),
    
    lwr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.05), 
    upr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.95) ) |> 
  
  # Back-transform all estimates
  pivot_longer(cols = Mu:upr_pred90, 
               names_to = "est", 
               values_to = "value") |> 
  inner_join(fat_sum_compl) |> 

  mutate(value_org = exp(value * s + m)) |> 
  
  select(FA:est, fa, value_org) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = est, 
              values_from = value_org) |> 
  
  mutate(time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4"), 
         treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega"), 
         treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
  

  

  add_row(
    fat_dat_compl |> 
      filter(time == "T1") |> 
      summarise(.by = c(time, treat, fa), 
                Mu = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
      mutate(TX = NA, 
             TI = NA,
             FA = NA, 
              treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) 
  ) 
  

## Plotting predictions with data  
AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  filter(participant %in% fat_dat_compl2$participant)  |> 

  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4")) |>
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) |>
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
  
  
  ggplot(aes(time, value, color = treat, group = paste(participant, fa))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
  
   ## Add model predictions

  geom_errorbar(data = m3_sum, 
                aes(time, Mu, 
                    ymin = lwr99, 
                    ymax = upr99, 
                    group = treat,
                    color = NULL), 
                width = 0.1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  

    geom_line(data = m3_sum, 
            aes(time, Mu, group = treat, color = NULL), 
            alpha = 1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  

    geom_point(data = m3_sum, 
             aes(time, Mu, fill = treat, group = NULL),
             color = "black",
             size = 3,
             alpha = 1,
             shape = 21, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +

  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) +
  
   facet_wrap(~ fa, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(y = "Fatty acid concentration (&mu;g ml<sup>-1</sup>)", 
       x = "Time point", 
       fill = "Treatment", 
       color = "Treatment") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"),   
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 12), 
        legend.position = "inside", 
        legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.1))
```

```{r}
### Contrasts
draws.m3 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 

    # Compute contrasts
    mutate(treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega")) |> 
    select(.iteration:TI, treat, alpha) |> 
  
    pivot_wider(names_from = treat, 
                values_from = alpha) |> 
    
    mutate(contrats = omega - ctrl, 
           rel_contrast = exp(contrats), 
           time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4")) |>
    
    inner_join(fat_sum_compl) |> 
    
    ggplot(aes(x = rel_contrast, 
               fill = time)) + 
    geom_density(alpha = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ fa, scales = "free") +
    
    labs(x = "Fold-difference (N-3 vs. Placebo)", 
         y = "Posterior density", 
         fill = "Time-point") +
    theme_classic() + 
  
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.2), 
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             lty = 2, 
             color = "gray50") +


  
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale)
```

## Does omega-3 supplementation, strength training, or their combination reduce the prevalence of metabolic syndrome compared to placebo?

A first analysis defines metabolic syndrome prevalence as the proportion of participants identified as having at least three out of five diagnostic criteria for metabolic syndrome. The analysis is complete-case analysis including individuals with at least three out of five criteria measurements over three studies time-point (pre-intervention, T1; post-supplementation, T2; post-supplementation + strength training, T4 @tbl-logregparticipants). 


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: tbl-logregparticipants


# Counting up the number of participants in the complete-case analysis 
# of metabolic syndrome.
d <- criteria_dat |> 
  
  filter(participant %in% participant_complete_T4) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(participant, time, treat, sex, age), 
            n = n(),
            n_threshold = sum(threshold, na.rm = TRUE) ) |> 
  
  mutate(met_syn = if_else(n_threshold >= 3, 1, 0), 
         age = (age - mean(age)) / sd(age)) 



# How many participants is in this analysis?
d |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(time, treat, sex), 
            n = n(), 
            met_sym = sum(met_syn)) |> 
  arrange(time, treat) |> 
  
  
  mutate(n_prev = paste0(n, " (", round(100 * (met_sym/n), 0), "%)")) |> 
  select(-n, -met_sym) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = n_prev)  |> 
  
  mutate(sex = if_else(sex == "m", "Male", "Female"), 
         treat = if_else(treat == "ctrl", "Placebo", "N-3")) |> 
  
  bind_rows(
    d |> 
      
     summarise(.by = c(time, treat), 
            n = n(), 
            met_sym = sum(met_syn)) |> 
       arrange(time, treat) |> 
  
  
  mutate(n_prev = paste0(n, " (", round(100 * (met_sym/n), 0), "%)"))  |> 
  select(-n, -met_sym) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = n_prev)  |> 
  
  mutate(sex = "Total",
         treat = if_else(treat == "ctrl", "Placebo", "N-3")) |> 
  select(treat, sex, T1:T4) 
  ) |> 
  

  group_by(sex) |> 
  gt() |> 
  fmt_markdown() |> 
  tab_spanner(label = "Time", 
              columns = 2:5) |> 
  
  cols_label(treat = "") |> 
  tab_footnote(footnote = "Data are presnted as n (Metabolic syndrom proportion)")

```

```{r}
#| echo: false

#| warning: false
#| label: fig-metsyndrome

d |> 
  filter(participant %in% participant_complete) |> 
  
  filter(n >= 5) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(time, treat), 
            n = n(), 
            crit = sum(met_syn), 
            rel = crit / n ) |> 
  
      mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(time, rel * 100, fill = treat)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           width = 0.5,

           color = "black",
           position = position_dodge(0.6)) +
  
  
  
  labs(y = "Occurance of metabolic syndrome (%)", 
       x = "Time point", 
       fill = "Treatment") + 
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 40), 
                     breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50), 
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
    scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) +
  
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"),   
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 12), 
        legend.position = "inside", 
        legend.position.inside = c(0.88, 0.85), 
        legend.background = element_rect(color = "black"))
```

```{r}
broom.mixed::tidy(m1) |> 
  select(term:p.value) |>

  )) |>

         Estimate = estimate,

  gt() |> 
  fmt_markdown(columns = Parameter)  |> 
  fmt_auto()
```

### Intention-to-treat analysis with imputed missing values



### Bayesian ITT-models

The goal here is to develop a Bayesian ITT model with missing data imputation to compare the treatment groups across all subcategories of the metabolic syndrome diagnostic criteria.

A first model is built to retrieve sub-score treatment effects (Blood pressure, HDL, Resting glucose, Triglycerides and Waist circumference). 

$$
\begin{align}
y_i &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(\mu_i, \sigma_i) \\
\mu_i 

\end{align}
$$




```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: fig-s1-priorpred
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive check of model s1. "



d_full <- criteria_dat |> 
  select(participant, time, treat, sex, age, analyte, value) |>
  # Add missing values for all missing obs. 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = value) |> 

  pivot_longer(cols = c(T1, T2, T4), 
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "time" ) |> 
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = analyte, 
              values_from = value) |> 

    pivot_longer(cols = HDL:HOMA2IR, 
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "analyte" ) |> 
  
  mutate(value_std = if_else(analyte %in% c("TG", "HOMA2IR"), log(value), value)) |> 
  

  
  mutate(.by = analyte, 
         value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  # To make all variables similarly signed HDL is reversed. 
  # Expected improvement in scores will be in the negative direction 
  # for all criteria markers
  mutate(value_std = if_else(analyte == "HDL", 
                         -value_std, value_std)) |> 
  mutate(participant = paste0("p", participant)) 

  

d_nomiss <- d_full |> 
  filter(!is.na(value_std)) 



# Using complete cases for T2 and T4
dat <- d_nomiss |> 
 
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T4")) |> 
  filter(.by = participant, 
         sum(!is.na(value_std)) == 16) |> 
  
  mutate(type = dense_rank(analyte), 
         participant = dense_rank(participant), 
         treat_seq = dense_rank(treat) ) |> 
  select(-value) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = value_std) 





d <- list(P = dat$participant, 
          y = dat$T4, 
          pre = dat$T1, 
          type = dat$type, 
          K = length(unique(dat$type)),
          N_P = length(unique(dat$participant)),
          N_TX = 2,
          treat = dat$treat_seq, 
          N = nrow(dat))


## Compile the first model 

# Compiling the model
s1 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s1.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/s1.exe")


# For prior predictive checking
d$prior_only <- 1
fit_wrap(s1, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s1")

draws.s1 <- fit.s1$draws(format = "df")

draws.s1 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("beta"), 
         starts_with("alpha"), 
         starts_with("sigma"),
         .draw
         ) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(starts_with("beta"), 
         starts_with("alpha"), 
         starts_with("sigma"))) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("parameter", "type"), 
           sep = "\\[") |> 
   separate(type, into = c("type", "treat"), 
           sep = ",") |> 

  mutate(type = gsub("\\]", "", type), 
         treat = gsub("\\]", "", treat)) |> 
  mutate(parameter = if_else(!is.na(treat), paste0(parameter, treat), 
                             parameter)) |> 
  select(-treat) |> 

  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.4)) |> 
  
  rowwise() |> 
  
  mutate(placebo_pred = rnorm(1, alpha1 + beta * pre, sigma), 
         omega_pred =   rnorm(1,   alpha2 + beta * pre, sigma)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(placebo = alpha1 + beta * pre, 
         omega = alpha1 + beta * pre) |> 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = placebo_pred:omega, 
               names_to = "treat") |>
  separate(treat, into = c("treat", "interval")) |> 
  mutate(interval = if_else(is.na(interval), "mean", interval)) |> 

  summarise(.by = c(pre, treat, type, interval), 
            m = mean(value), 
            lwr = quantile(value, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(value, 0.95)) |> 

  
  mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("placebo", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) |> 

  ggplot(aes(pre, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, group = interval)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(type ~ treat) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5,5)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-5,5)) + 
  labs(y = "Prior predictive mean (90% PI)", 
       x = "Pre-intervention scores") + 
  alpha_theme() + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6

# Model performance
s1_sum <- fit.s1p$summary()

# Get (most) problematic parameters
vars <- s1_sum |> 
  arrange(-rhat) |> 
   filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  slice_head(n = 3) |> 
  pull(variable)



p1 <- s1_sum |> 
  filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  mutate(variable_type = variable) |> 
  separate(variable_type, into = c("variable_type", "index"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  
  mutate(highlight = if_else(variable %in% vars, variable, "")) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(ess_bulk, rhat, size = ess_tail, color = variable_type)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = highlight, 
                color = NULL, 
                size = NULL), 
                show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  labs(x = "(Bulk) effective sample size", 
       y = "R-hat", 
       color = "Parameter type", 
       size = "(Tail) effective sample size") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale)




draws.s1 <- fit.s1p$draws(format = "df")


p2  <- draws.s1 |> 
  select(.iteration, .chain, all_of(vars)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(.iteration, value, 
             color = as.factor(.chain))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ name, ncol = 1, 
             scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  labs(x = "Iteration", 
       color = "Chain", 
       y = "Parameter value")



p1 / p2
```

```{r}
dat |>

s4 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s4.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/s4.exe")



d$prior_only <- 0

fit.s4 <- s4$sample(
        data = d,                 # The list of variables
        iter_sampling = 2000,      # Number of iterations for sampling
        iter_warmup = 1000,        # Number of warm-up iterations
        chains = 4,                # Number of Markov chains
        parallel_chains = 4,
        refresh = 1000             # Number of iterations before each print
)

            miss_pre = 5 - sum(pre_miss),

## Compare models on complete data

  arrange(P) |>

            miss_y = 5 - sum(y_miss), 
            miss_pre = 5 - sum(pre_miss), 
            sex = mean(sex)) |> 
  filter(miss_y == 0 ) |>

loo_compare(log_lik.s3, log_lik.s4)
```

```{r}
  )

  mutate(contrast = alpha2 - alpha1) |> 
  select(.draw, type, contrast, time) |> 

  summarise(.by = c(type, time), 
            m = mean(contrast), 
            lwr = quantile(contrast, 0.025), 
            upr = quantile(contrast, 0.975)) |> 
  
  mutate(type = case_when(
    type == 1 ~ "HDL", 
    type == 2 ~ "Triglycerides", 
    type == 3 ~ "Blood pressure",
    type == 4 ~ "Fasting glucose", 
    type == 5 ~ "Waist curcumference",
  )) |> 
    mutate(Analysis = "ITT (imputed missing values)")
  ) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes("Contrast", m, color = time, alpha = Analysis)) + 
  
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), 
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.4, 1)) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ type, ncol = 1, scales = "free") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2)
```

```{r}
## Comparing completers with drop-out in pre scores

d_full |> 
  filter(time == "T1") |> 
  
  mutate(completer = if_else(dense_rank(participant ) %in% compl_dat_id, 
                             1, 0)) |> 
  
  
  
  ggplot(aes(value, color = as.factor(completer))) + geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~ analyte, scales = "free")
  
  print()
```
